lines.text: Asaph cried aloud to God in his day of trouble, and his soul refused to be comforted.
Asaph thought of the days of old and asked whether God's promise had failed and His compassion was shut off.
Asaph grieved that the right hand of the Most High had changed, so he decided to forget the works of the LORD.

wrong_details.wrong: decided to forget the works of the LORD
wrong_details.true: decided to remember the works of the LORD

lines.text: Asaph said God's way is holy and that with power He redeemed the sons of Moab and Ammon.

wrong_details.wrong: the sons of Moab and Ammon
wrong_details.true: the sons of Jacob and Joseph

lines.text: The waters saw God and swirled, the earth quaked, and He led His people like a flock by Moses and Aaron.
